import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Define colors for species
species_colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=species_colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species')

# Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60, color=species_colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species')

# Box plot: Sepal Length distribution by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='species', y='sepal_length', palette=species_colors, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Box plot: Petal Length distribution by species
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=species_colors, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Analysis: Flower Measurements by Species', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
